summary: The document defines a set of role constants within a static class in a namespace.
purpose: The RoleConstants class provides a centralized location for defining and managing access role constants used throughout the application.

fields.name: NIS
fields.description: Role constant for NIS (Network Information System).

fields.name: IRP
fields.description: Role constant for IRP (Individual Role Profile).

business_rules: RoleConstants must be immutable and used globally wherever role checks are necessary.
system_behavior: The RoleConstants class is used to replace hardcoded role strings with named constants, enhancing code readability and maintainability.
